meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Weather.com: ad blocks, app button and Taboola links, plus news rails, radar and health module controls
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13: the rendered DOM of weather.com home and the New York City Today page, captured with headless Chrome (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA), logged out; counts and fixtures come from those captures (headless Chrome later ran out of memory when re-fetching, so selectors were re-counted on the saved DOM, not a second live load). Fixtures real.html (phone Today), home.html (phone Home), desktop-real.html (desktop Home) and desktop-today.html are structural captures with text stripped.

LIVE counts: `section[aria-label="Advertisement"]` 2 to 7 per page, `[data-testid^="WX_"][data-testid$="-container"]` 5 on desktop Home (WindowShade, Bot300AdX1 to X5) and 1 on phone Today, `[data-testid^="MW_"][data-testid$="-container"]` 1 to 2 (Position5, Interstitial), `[data-testid="get-app-button"]` 1 on phone Home and Today, `[id^="taboola-"]` 4 on desktop and 1 on phone Today, `.trc_rbox_container` 3 desktop, rails Trending Now, Your News, News, Editor's Pick and Reviews & Recommendations 1 each on desktop Home, `section[aria-label^="Radar"]` 1 on every page, Health & Activities 1 and Activity Hub 1 on phone Today.

The aria labels are English-only, so rail, radar and health rules do nothing on weather.com in other languages. The `WX_`/`MW_` test ids are ad-slot names (each has a matching `gptm-` Google Publisher Tag id) and can be renamed by the site. The Google One Tap sign-in prompt that users report (uBlockOrigin uAssets issue 29446) did not render in headless Chrome and has no rule. The video player and the forecast, conditions and daily cards are never targeted. NOT verified: logged-in pages, the ad-blocker notice, video autoplay.
